items.title: Only half of primary school kids have ‘satisfactory knowledge’ of language and maths
items.description: Only 50% of schoolkids in Argentina reach sixth grade with ‘satisfactory knowledge of language and maths,’ finds NGO report, but 94 in 100 pupils reached sixth grade without dropping out or repeating a year. Leer más

items.title: Germany: Bundeswehr troop numbers reach 13-year high
items.description: Germany's Defense Ministry is reporting a comparatively rare success story in its bid to bolster troop numbers. At the end of July, the total stood at around 186,700, roughly 3,700 more than a year earlier — a 2% boost.

items.title: ICC slams United States sanctions against top court staff
items.description: It measures against the ICC president and a senior trial lawyer are the latest salvo by Washington against the court which it accuses of being "politicised".

items.description: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.
